integrity: The exact infinite theorem is proved by a Venn-cell pebble invariant and explicit distance-formula witnesses. Finite Python checks corroborate but cannot certify all parameters.
scientific_limitations: Relative classification inside Johnson graph family; no conclusion for counting quantifiers, merged Johnson graphs, general basis graphs, Grassmann graphs, or quantifier rank equals variable width. Prior three-variable distance-regular and rank-two triangular cases are not new. Possible unlocated stronger general theorem; independent mathematical audit not performed.
scientific_scope: Pure equality/adjacency on finite Johnson graphs with normalized ranks at least three, ordinary noncounting first-order logic and all variable widths at least four.
title: Sharp unrestricted variable-width hierarchy for Johnson graphs beyond three variables
